title: SEC Filings - EDGAR Forms, Dates & 公司公告
description: Minimal working input: {"ciks": ["320193"], "forms": [], "sinceDate": "", "untilDate": ""}. Default maximum 20 paid filing rows; only delivered rows billed.

ciks.title: ciks
ciks.description: SEC company CIK numbers as strings, e.g. ["320193"] for Apple. Leading zeroes accepted. Ticker symbols are not supported. One page budget per company.

forms.title: forms
forms.description: Optional exact SEC form names, e.g. ["10-K", "10-Q"]. Empty [] includes all forms. Filtered filings are not billed.

sinceDate.title: sinceDate
sinceDate.description: Inclusive start date, e.g. "2026-01-01", for filing_date, not report_date. Empty means no lower bound. Free filter within maxPages.

untilDate.title: untilDate
untilDate.description: Inclusive end date, e.g. "2026-12-31", for filing_date, not report_date. Empty means no upper bound. Free filter within maxPages.

maxResults.title: maxResults
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the entire run, after filters and exclusions. Example: 20. May return fewer when source pages end or maxPages is reached.

maxPages.title: maxPages
maxPages.description: Maximum source pages per target, 1–20; default 3. One current submissions file plus older archive files per CIK; a file often contains around 1,000 filings. Filters are free; maxResults can be lower than this scan budget.

includeKeywords.title: includeKeywords
includeKeywords.description: Case-insensitive OR substring filter on id (normalized CIK:accession_number), e.g. ["320193"] for the CIK part of Apple filing IDs. Empty [] disables it. Does not search company names, document descriptions or filing body text. Applied before billing within the page budget; not a source search or semantic classifier.
includeKeywords.sectionCaption: Filters and repeat runs / 筛选与去重

excludeIds.title: excludeIds
excludeIds.description: Copy prior output id values here to skip before billing. id is normalized CIK:accession_number. Empty [] disables it. This also suppresses changes to existing IDs.

excludeContentHashes.title: excludeContentHashes
excludeContentHashes.description: SHA-256 content_hash values from previous output to skip unchanged snapshots before billing. Example: copy returned hashes. Empty [] disables it. Changed counters or content can produce a new paid snapshot.
